works.body:
It is nice to meet you. I have been looking at your illustrations for some time and would like to make this request.

About the contents of the request
I would like you to draw a man and woman in a long-distance relationship. We both enjoy playing games and cherish the time we spend playing games together and keeping in touch.

The boy has a fluffy haircut and his hair color is a little lighter brown. He is older than the girl and has a cheerful personality that is adored by those around him.

Girls have bob to medium bob haircuts and their hair color is milk tea beige. They often smile brightly.

The boy and girl's clothing and composition are all up to you.

Intended use
For personal viewing.
It may be used for icons and headers of social networking sites such as X (formerly Twitter).
No commercial use.

We understand that you are busy, but we appreciate your consideration.

はじめまして、Dingという宇宙人Vtuberです。 
先生の絵柄、線の描き方も、構図のアイデアも大大大大好きです。   

もしできれば、Dingのイラストを描いていただきたいです。 
彼女はコーヒー、任天堂さんのゲーム、猫も大好きです。
もしよければ、宇宙風な構図をお願いしたいです。

イラストはSNSと動画のサムネが使いたいです。
もし良ければ透明背景なPNGもお願いします。
   
キャラの設定についでリングを参考↓  https://drive.google.com/file/d/17G_271cf8jptv5E_Is7wI8wC8vvoiSDX/view?usp=sharing
